transcript.content: Hi, welcome in — I'm Dr. Lee. What brings you in to see me today?

Ever since I started getting foreclosure notices, I feel like I’m just coming apart. I cry in my truck before work, and every time the phone rings I jump. I’ve been snapping at the apprentices, and I’m making dumb mistakes in the repair bay that I normally never would.
When did you first start feeling this way in relation to when you received the first foreclosure notice?
I was okay before the letters and calls started. Then within a few weeks of that first formal foreclosure notice, things at work and at home just started falling apart.
Besides the crying and irritability, have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy, or any changes in your sleep or appetite since this all started?

I’ve kind of pulled away from everything I used to do. I stopped going to my church volunteer stuff, fitness classes, and the truck-club outings. At work they’ve taken me out of the high-risk repair bay, too.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep since this all started—trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or sleeping much more than usual?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to my sleep, honestly.
Since this all began, have you been feeling constantly on edge or worried about many different things—not just the foreclosure—like your health, family, or other everyday matters?
I’m not sure I’d say it’s about everything. Mostly it’s been the foreclosure and what that’s doing to my life.
Aside from worrying specifically about the foreclosure, do you notice physical signs of anxiety—like feeling tense, restless, your heart racing, or your muscles tight—when you think about it?
I’m not sure I’ve noticed physical stuff like that. When I think about it, I just feel upset and stressed, I guess.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight since all this began—eating noticeably more or less than usual?
I haven’t really noticed a change in my appetite or weight. I haven’t been paying close attention to that.
Since this all started, have you been having thoughts that you're worthless, a failure, or excessively guilty about things?
I don’t know. I’ve been feeling really bad about the situation, but I wouldn’t say I’m constantly thinking I’m worthless or anything.
Since this all began, have you noticed feeling unusually tired or low on energy, even when you haven't been more physically active than usual?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed being unusually tired or having less energy than normal.
Since all this began, have you had any thoughts of death or of hurting yourself, or felt like life isn't worth living?
No, I haven’t had thoughts about hurting myself or dying. I don’t feel like life isn’t worth living.
Since this all started, would you say you generally feel nervous, anxious, or on edge much of the time, even apart from the physical sensations we talked about?
Yeah. Ever since the foreclosure notices started coming, I’ve been really on edge. I jump every time the phone rings, and it feels like I’m just coming apart at the seams.
Since this all started, have you been feeling sad, down, or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Yeah… I’ve been pretty down since the foreclosure notices started. I’ve cried in my truck before work more than once. It feels like I’m coming apart.
